text:
ana: Fresh laptop onboarding hit a quickstart blocker. Brew install -> `redwoodctl init` -> `redwoodctl login --headless` but CLI never sees callback.

marc: what platform?

ana: macOS M1 with company VPN and a Docker container running the sample app. Browser redirected to http://127.0.0.1:12345 but CLI stayed at `waiting for callback`. After ~30s it started spamming `login failed: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority`.

marc: two failures mixed: bind semantics (container/host) and corp TLS inspection. Which error came first?

ana: the initial symptom was no callback accepted; later the CLI retried and surfaced the x509 error when TLS started failing.

marc: quick wins: 1) make postinstall message include `--profile quickstart` so sample apps and init match, 2) doctor check to detect Docker/WSL/VPN and suggest `--local-callback-host=0.0.0.0` or `--device-code` for CI/containers.

ana: also the env had `SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/corp.pem`. curl worked with `--cacert` but redwoodctl ignores SSL_CERT_FILE. New hires are confused.

marc: we should at minimum detect SSL_CERT_FILE/REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE and warn. Mid-term add `--trust-local-ca /path/to/ca.pem` for headless flows (session-only).

devex-bot: FYI: small PR idea — slow retries (exp backoff 1s->4s->12s), single spinner and an actionable hint after 10s instead of repeated lines.

ana: that would have helped. The repetitive logs made it look like the CLI was broken.

marc: agree. Also change `init` to be interactive if a `default` profile exists and show a one-line summary (active profile, files created). Installer postinstall should instruct `redwoodctl init --profile quickstart` explicitly.

devex-bot: plan: (A) doctor: detect env cert vars, docker/WSL, webview2; (B) CLI: add `--local-callback-host`, `--trust-local-ca` (session-only), reduce retry spam; (C) docs: update postinstall text and quickstart to mention `--device-code` fallback.

ci-bot: deploy-check: docs branch `devex/cli-onboard-fixes` lint OK

ana: filing issue with logs and proposed small PRs for doctor + retry/backoff + postinstall text. Tagging devex and eng-platform.

marc: thanks — please include a short example for `--trust-local-ca` and clarify it won't persist to system stores.
